name_reality_gap: Labeled Consulting Finance & Insurance; Ryan is a tax-only specialist firm — its entire business is tax services, tax recovery and tax technology, with no insurance or general finance practice; the label implies broader finance scope that does not match.
extraction_notes: Two clear sources. 7,100 professionals and 74,000+ clients in 80+ countries are directly quoted. Practice area list is comprehensive and directly sourced from the services navigation. Private company so revenue not disclosed.
